title: MV Square: Trial and Error. Steam sale! 35% off!

posts.author: Arcaines
posts.body:
Click here to go to the Steam page!
The game!
Join Mr Square in an epic adventure to save town Square from the Glitch Zone!
You'll need to complete 20 Trial and Error puzzles and push back the glitch Zone!
Each level has it's own different set of rules you must avoid or
obey in order to clear the level!
Interact in a fun Town full of NPCS!
Discover the many secrets of the town!
Find, name and bring pets with you on your adventure!
Streamer Island update!
Streamer Island update is now here! Which brings even more levels, music, pets and outfits for you to complete!
The New levels are:​
Natties Nonsentical Box Factory​
Nattie Geo owns a wonderful but crazy box factory! But she's gone missing! Can you figure out the correct boxes to carry to get yourself through the factory and restore order to the madness?
Ambers Day Care​
Hold your breath because here we go! Dive deep into the ocean and into Amber's Daycare center, where she cares for her Awklets! But 3 have wandered of,f and it's up to you to find! Just don't hold your breath for too long.
Kai's Kool Forest​
Well, someone is hungry, but their deilverwohoo person refuses to enter the slime-coated Forest, of course, you can't let a slime go hungry, take up the order, collect those slime balls to unlock those doors, and deliver his food!
Wookee's Wacky Mansion​
Did you hear that? Sounds like a zombie moan, annnnd Wookee is in trouble again. Solve the puzzles and help Wookee escape the terrifying Zombies that hunger for his soul! Save the Wookee!
Kennis Mythical Forest​
What is this strange statue doing? Who is this mysterious Fairy? Well, anywho, he thinks your an Adventrure so you've been set to complete his trial! And don't forget to take your good friend with you!
Ebony Rose Garden​
Chaos, beauty, and wonder await you in the Ebony Rose garden! Care to go to the Tavern? Maybe explore the maze? Or visit the Queen of Chaos? Either way, your soul now belongs to her!
Streamers Player Square!
Square has proven to be quite popular with Streamers,
all who have played said they have enjoyed the game!
Features:
20 Trial and Error Levels (Demo contains 7 levels)
5 Bonus levels (Demo contains 2)
2 Extra levels!
Change your outfit!
Form your own party of NPCs!
Add pets to your party!
Build and design your own home!
An interactive home where you can learn about flags!
Collect music sheets and new house skins
and many more secrets to find!
Screenshots!
